posts.text: A 2021 analysis of the bones of Pompeii victims reveals residents scarfed a lot of seafood and olive oil, confirming historians’ estimates that average Romans consumed 20 liters (more than 5 gallons) of the oil each year. https://scim.ag/4hc21Wi #ScienceMagArchives
posts.external_title: Ancient Roman vacationers consumed gobs of olive oil and fish, volcano victims reveal

posts.text: The Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) shapes the Earth’s climate, but climate warming is weakening it. Marine sediments show that an AMOC slowdown during the last glacial period increased sediment discharge from South America. In PNAS: https://ow.ly/svNJ50ZP8IG
